provenance_do_not_read_these_as_part_of_.note: These details were NOT in the original freeze. They are an amendment, auditable as such without relying on anyone's account of intent.
amendment_2d8d4592_added: fixed-policy selection occurs on half A, symmetric with the adaptive mapping
SPECIALIST_INCREMENTAL_VALUE and SELECTED_POLICY_PER_OPPONENT as mandatory reports
paired bootstrap reported alongside the frozen Wald gates
provenance_do_not_read_these_as_part_of_.these_step_counts_are_historical: they record the run position when this amendment was frozen, not the current position of either run

why_this_is_an_amendment_and_not_result_.state_at_amendment: S_OP7 at 786,432 and S_OP8 at 772,096 of 1,000,000 steps. NEITHER specialist has been evaluated. No cross-play cell, no gate score, and no delta_pool value exists for either policy.
why_this_is_an_amendment_and_not_result_.verification: artifacts/vgc_specialists/ contains no evaluation output of any kind
why_this_is_an_amendment_and_not_result_.principle: these changes fix an under-specification and a statistical asymmetry BEFORE any outcome is observable. They cannot flatter a result that does not exist. Amendments after any gate is scored would not be legitimate.

amendment_1_evaluation_seed_block.defect: the frozen evaluation block specified episodes_per_cell and paired seeds but never named a seed BASE. run_crossplay_eval.py therefore defaults to run_g0_v2_evaluation.EVAL_SEED_BASE = 9100000, giving seeds 9100000-9100059.
amendment_1_evaluation_seed_block.consequence: seeds 9100000-9100029 ARE the discovery block that produced the 56-cell matrix, and OP7/OP8 was selected because of what that matrix showed. Half of every specialist eval cell would reuse the exact environment realizations that chose the target axis.
amendment_1_evaluation_seed_block.severity: less circular than re-scoring D1/D7 on the same data, since neither specialist existed at discovery. But a reviewer could reasonably ask whether OP7/OP8 was selected partly because those particular seeds exaggerated the contrast.
amendment_1_evaluation_seed_block.resolution: the specialist confirmatory evaluation uses a DISJOINT block, base 9300000, seeds 9300000-9300059.
amendment_1_evaluation_seed_block.this_fills_a_gap_rather_than_overriding_: the frozen protocol was SILENT on the seed base. Nothing frozen said 9100000. Had it been explicitly frozen, the correct action would have been to preserve it and add the disjoint block as a separate independent confirmation.

block_allocation.requirement: mutually disjoint, and all disjoint from every training seed block

amendment_2_V_fixed_must_be_selected_on_.defect: the frozen SPLIT_HALF_ORACLE rule read 'The per-opponent argmax policy is SELECTED on half A and SCORED on half B. V_fixed is likewise scored on half B.' It never stated that V_fixed's ARGMAX is also chosen on half A.
amendment_2_V_fixed_must_be_selected_on_.consequence: the natural implementation takes max-over-policies for V_fixed on half B, which gives the fixed baseline the same optimistic selection advantage that split-half was introduced to remove from the adaptive side. Adaptive selection would be debiased while the baseline was not, treating the two asymmetrically and biasing delta_pool DOWNWARD.
amendment_2_V_fixed_must_be_selected_on_.resolution: BOTH the per-opponent adaptive mapping AND the identity of the single best fixed policy are chosen on half A. Both are then scored, frozen, on half B.

half_A: choose the single best fixed policy by mean WR across opponents
half_B: score the frozen per-opponent mapping -> V_selective
score the frozen fixed policy -> V_fixed

amendment_2_V_fixed_must_be_selected_on_.not_adopted_now: 2-fold cross-fitting (A selects/B scores, B selects/A scores, average) is more sample-efficient and would be preferable in a redesign. The single split is valid, only noisier, and changing the estimator structure mid-flight is a larger change than fixing the asymmetry. Recorded as the preferred design for any future replication.

amendment_3_specialist_incremental_value.defect: gate3 permits the selective oracle to choose among all five policies. If the existing generalists win both target columns -- OP7 to D7-3200001 and OP8 to D1-3600001 -- while S_OP7 and S_OP8 merely cross each other at a lower level, then gate1, gate2 and gate3 can ALL pass without the specialists having contributed anything.

the_two_claims_this_confuses.claim_actually_supported: the five-policy candidate pool has selective value, and the direct specialists exhibit complementarity
the_two_claims_this_confuses.claim_that_would_be_wrongly_reported: S_OP7/S_OP8 created a useful specialist repertoire

amendment_3_specialist_incremental_value.resolution: the primary gate is NOT changed. Two diagnostics are added and must be reported alongside any gate3 verdict.

SPECIALIST_INCREMENTAL_VALUE.definition: V_selective(all five) - V_selective(three existing policies only, specialists excluded)
SPECIALIST_INCREMENTAL_VALUE.must_not_reintroduce_selection_bias: BOTH mappings are chosen on half A and scored on half B. Computing 'best all-five selective value' and 'best incumbents-only selective value' independently on the scoring half would give each its own winner's-curse optimism, and the difference of two independently-optimistic quantities is not interpretable.

half_A: choose the per-opponent selective mapping over ALL FIVE policies
choose the per-opponent selective mapping over the THREE incumbents only

SPECIALIST_INCREMENTAL_VALUE.uncertainty: paired bootstrap over half-B episodes, 10000 resamples

required_reports.SELECTED_POLICY_PER_OPPONENT: the identity of the policy the SELECTION half actually chose for each of OP6-OP12
required_reports.interpretation_rule: if neither specialist is ever selected on the selection half, the specialists contributed no repertoire value regardless of whether gate3 passed. This must be stated explicitly in the readout, not left for a reader to infer.

amendment_3_specialist_incremental_value.why_it_matters_downstream: the teachers for any latent compression stage are chosen from whichever policies actually carry the selective value. Mistaking pool value for specialist value would send the latent phase off with the wrong teachers.

amendment_4_robustness_reporting.change: alongside the frozen Wald LCB95 for gate1 and gate2, report a paired episode-level bootstrap CI (10000 resamples).
amendment_4_robustness_reporting.why: episode seeds are paired across policies, so a paired estimator uses the design; Wald intervals for Bernoulli proportions behave poorly near 0 and 1, and several cells on this board sit above .95.
amendment_4_robustness_reporting.status: REPORTED ALONGSIDE, NOT A GATE. The frozen Wald criterion remains the decision rule; the bootstrap is a robustness check for the writeup. If the two disagree, that disagreement is itself reported.

prohibited: any further amendment after a gate has been scored
reusing block 9100000-9100029 for any specialist cell
reporting gate3 without SPECIALIST_INCREMENTAL_VALUE and SELECTED_POLICY_PER_OPPONENT
